source: Owner message on 2026-10-17 at 02:07 UTC to the Claude Code session doing the community article work, about its owner questions page.
owner_statement: now you say for me to do (no decision needed) then ask me to make 2 decisions, emrging and accepting changes, funny.
problem: The page's section "For you to do (no decision needed)", named as this pattern named it, asked the owner to merge the work and to say "accept 13 and 14" or what to change. A merge is his OK on the work and an acceptance is a decision, so the heading said the opposite of what the items asked.
required_behavior: The section is "For you to do": actions only the owner can take, with no claim that nothing needs deciding.
A decision is never listed there: accepting finished work, choosing between options, or saying what to change is a numbered open question with options.
